invented_requirements: The contract adds new leading- and trailing-colon PYTHONPATH behavior for an arbitrary preserved sys.path[0], requiring value-qualified removal of a following exact cwd entry. The public request only asked to guard removal of the first entry, and the repository did not establish this arbitrary-prefix behavior.
The acceptance requirement for explicit leading- and trailing-colon arbitrary-prefix regression cases exceeds the minimum issue-requested regression coverage.
summary: The interview accurately recalled every explicit owner answer and produced a coherent, approved, implementation-ready contract grounded in the repository’s entry-point, path-stripping, and compatibility tests. Its main fidelity loss is scope expansion: it turned an uncited interaction between preserved arbitrary prefixes and PYTHONPATH colon handling into required behavior and mandatory coverage. Diagnostic hindsight confirms the gold change guarded only sys.path[0] while retaining the existing index-based colon logic, so that expanded requirement was not necessary to match the accepted upstream fix; this hindsight does not create an issue-time blocker.
